name: HaRVey Campground
note: City of Harvey campground on the north shore of the Sheyenne River above Harvey Dam, at the southeast edge of town: angled gravel pads off a shoreline road beside a fishing dock. The dump station is across town at 7th St and Park Ave. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Harvey Lodging & Camping page (harveynd.com/lodging-camping, read 2026-11-12): 'HaRVey Campground - Harvey's newest campground located just off Business Highway 52 along the Sheyenne River. We have 10 camp sites with electricity available. There are no water or sewer services available. Daily rate: $15', pay online or at the City Hall payment box, 'Call or Email for Reservations', address 944 Business Hwy 52, phone 701-324-2000 Auditor's office, park rules of 'the City of Harvey and Harvey JDA'; ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) row 156: HARVEY PARK, 944 Business Highway 52, Harvey, Wells County, owner CITY OF HARVEY, licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 8/2/2023, 10 lots -> a city campground on an agency list (public ladder step 1). RV Life 'Harvey Campground' (park 270225; 944 Business Highway 52, phone 7013242000, pin 47.7637,-99.92269, city, 3*/$ on 1 rating, 10 sites): review of a July 2026 stay in a motorhome, site 10, back-in: 'A new City owned barebones RV park. Located on the SE corner of the city on the shore of the Sheyenne river. Fairly level gravel sites with very good 20/30/50 hookups', site space 'quite a bit longer than my motorhome and a towed vehicle', paid at City Hall -> operating in 2026. Esri imagery 2026-11-12 (4.4 km frame at 47.768,-99.935; 1.2 km at 47.7645,-99.9225; 320 m at 47.7638,-99.9232): ten angled gravel back-in pads, each ~20 m+ long with a post at its head, fanning off the north side of a gravel road that runs along the reservoir shore from Business 52 and loops at its west end, beside a fishing dock -> drive-in, a 23-ft rig fits. No horse facilities or mention, no road warning. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule. NOT 5991 West Side Park/Campground: separate HHS licence (row 422 WESTSIDE PARK, 504 8 St W, owner HARVEY PARK DISTRICT, 21 lots), separate operator (Park District vs City of Harvey/JDA), separate RV Life listing (249282), and it is the pool park on the NW edge of town, its camping loops ~1.9 km NW of this site. Long-stay test 4: only a daily rate is published (no weekly/monthly), 10 sites, the 2026 reviewer calls it a barebones transient park and imagery shows the pads empty -> passes, no caveat.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (4.4 km frame at 47.768,-99.935; 1.2 km at 47.7645,-99.9225; 320 m at 47.7638,-99.9232). The water is the Sheyenne River impounded behind Harvey Dam (~250-300 m wide here); the campground is on the upstream (reservoir) side of the dam - the impoundment ends at the Business 52 causeway ~350 m east, with the downstream channel beyond it (Open-Meteo DEM: pads 480 m, shore 470 m, downstream channel 468 m), so not below a dam berm. All ten pads sit on the inland side of the campground's own gravel road, which runs along the shore between every pad and the water; pad ends are ~20-40 m from the shoreline across that road and a mown-grass strip, with a fishing dock off the road. A loop road between site and water caps the value at a view (curation doc, Lake Tobesofkee Claystone rule) -> riverview, an open, unobstructed view of the water from every pad. 'River' follows the city's own wording ('along the Sheyenne River').
hookups_source: https://www.harveynd.com/lodging-camping ('10 camp sites with electricity available. There are no water or sewer services available'), read 2026-11-12; amperage from the RV Life review of a July 2026 stay (park 270225, motorhome, site 10: 'very good 20/30/50 hookups', power yes, water no, sewer no), read 2026-11-12 - the city does not publish amperage
sites_source: https://www.harveynd.com/lodging-camping ('10 camp sites'); ND HHS licensed list 07.17.2025 row 156 (10 lots); RV Life review July 2026 (back-in); Esri imagery read 2026-11-12 (ten angled back-in pads), read 2026-11-12
facilities_source: https://www.harveynd.com/lodging-camping (HaRVey Campground rules: 'The dump station is located at the corner of 7th Street and Park Ave'; that corner geocodes (Esri) to 47.77328,-99.93933 at West Side Park, ~1.6 km NW of the campground), read 2026-11-12

booking.note: Reservations by phone or email to the City Auditor (Mon-Thu 8-5, Fri 8-12) or the booking form on the city page; pay online (city payment portal) or at the City Hall payment box, 120 W 8th St.

booking_source: https://www.harveynd.com/lodging-camping ('Call or Email for Reservations', '701-324-2000 Auditor's office (Mon-Thurs 8-5 pm & Fri 8-12)', 'Contact Us for Booking ... so we can get you booked', 'pay online under our Live Harvey tab ... or drop payments off in the Payment Box located at 120 West 8th Street at City Hall'), read 2026-11-12
flags: Separate from 5991, not a duplicate: two HHS licences in the 07.17.2025 list (HARVEY PARK, City of Harvey, 944 Business Hwy 52, 10 lots; WESTSIDE PARK, Harvey Park District, 504 8 St W, 21 lots), two RV Life listings, ~1.9 km apart (this one on the reservoir shore at the SE edge of town, West Side the pool park on the NW edge). The city's camping page now describes only HaRVey, because West Side belongs to the Park District, not the city.
Amperage (50) rests on one RV Life camper review (July 2026, '20/30/50 hookups'); the city publishes only 'electricity'. Water/sewer false is the city's own statement.
Rate: city page $15 daily; the July 2026 RV Life reviewer entered $11 paid. The city's figure is used.
Season not published; booking.season and season left unwritten. Restrooms/water spigot not stated anywhere and none identifiable on imagery; facilities carries only dump: false.

Waterfront: riverview, not riverfront, because the campground's own shoreline road runs between every pad and the water (pads ~20-40 m from shore). The water is a wide reservoir; lakeview is the alternative reading if AWH prefers to name it as a lake.

For 5991 West Side Park/Campground (Harvey) - everything learned, for AWH's correction: (1) true pin: the stored 47.77099,-99.94416 sits on the US-52 bypass ramp ~300 m SW of the camping area; the gravel camping loops (shelters, small concrete pads) are at ~47.7737,-99.9432 (Esri imagery 2026-11-12; RV Life pin 47.77352,-99.94019 and Google 47.773449,-99.9401732 sit at the pool/park entrance on the east side). (2) Name/operator: HHS licensed list 07.17.2025 row 422 'WESTSIDE PARK', 504 8 St W, owner HARVEY PARK DISTRICT (not the City), licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 6/12/2023, 21 lots; ownership 'local' stands. (3) Sites: HHS 21 lots; RV Life cg_site_count 20; the old city page (per the stored evidence) said 17 electric. (4) Rate: RV Life reviews - Sept 2024 motorhome site 9G pull-through, $15/night with a weekly discount, power yes, water no ('Pads are concrete, but pretty small'); Sept 2023 travel trailer back-in $20, power yes, water yes; RV Life avg_rate $18, 3*/$ on 2 ratings. (5) Hookups: electric at all reviewed sites, water at some (2023 yes, 2024 no), no sewer; amperage unknown. (6) Dump: the city's rules place the dump station at 7th St & Park Ave, which geocodes to West Side Park's east edge, so 5991's facilities.dump: true is consistent. (7) Booking/season: nothing published; the Park District has no website (harveyparkdistrict.org is Illinois). (8) Website: both stored links are dead or unusable - harveynd.com/lodging-camping-in-harvey returns 404 and ndtourism refuses everyone; the city's current camping page (harveynd.com/lodging-camping) is about HaRVey, not West Side; RV Life's link is the old harveynd.com/lodging_camping.html. (9) Phone: three candidates, none on an operator page - stored (701) 324-2070, Google 'West Side Park/Campground' 701-324-2604 (4.4 on 22 reviews), RV Life 701-324-2628 (address '7th St W'). Still a phone-list candidate (operating status in 2026, rate, Park District contact).

Electric amperage from one RV Life review (July 2026, '20/30/50'); the city publishes only 'electricity'. That reviewer paid $11; the city page says $15. --Claude
